text:
rachel: Hi team  day 2 here. Quick: where should I put my onboarding notes (so others can find them)? I made a page under my workspace but want canonical location.

jordan: welcome! put them in Product > Onboarding > Ramp Notes or People Ops > New Hires depending on audience. personal workspace is fine for drafts but duplicate into the team space when ready.

rachel: duplicates confuse me how do I keep the metadata so automations pick it up?

kate: duplicate via the template flow: open Product Onboarding template -> Duplicate -> Move to Product > Onboarding. then fill the page properties: owner, role, start-date, template-version. automations use those props.

rachel: ok. i see a "template-version" field  what if i forget?

devex-bot: Reminder: missing "template-version" triggers ingest alert: INGEST_MISSING_METADATA. Fill it to avoid skipped pages.

people-ops: also, fill the "visibility" property. if this is internal-only mark Internal; contractors should be Guest. People Ops can set temporary access.

rachel: i need edit access to Product Onboarding. i only have view.

jordan: if you filled the First-week checklist your access request should be queued. if not, @people-ops can manually add you to product-editors for 90 days.

people-ops: i see no pending request for rachel. i'll trigger a page-level grant now. expect edit in 2-3 mins.

rachel: thanks! one more: are there naming conventions for page titles?

kate: yes use <lastname>-<role>-<startYYYYMMDD> e.g., "Nguyen-Product-20260212". keeps search predictable. also tag the page with the OKR/feature in the "linked-features" property so QE and SEs can find context.

rachel: perfect. i'll duplicate and move, fill frontmatter, then confirm. thanks y'all  would love a 10-min walkthrough on Notion conventions if anyone's free this afternoon.

jordan: happy to do 10-min at 3pm.

people-ops: done  granted "editor" on Product > Onboarding > Rachel-Product-20260212.

rachel: can see edit now  closing the loop :pray:
